description: Add an end user to the project (for apps where each user sees only their own records). No email is sent. Then call create_app_user_session to act as that user.

api_key.description: Project manage key (pro_...) returned by create_project. Public keys (pub_...) are read-only.

email.description: The user's email; it does not need to receive mail

name: create_app_user
title: Create an app user
